_doc: Texture styles of the shops agent (gTileset_Shop rooms: Poké Marts, Herb Shop, Lilycove Department Store, Cycling Road and Safari Zone entrances). All from Black 2's Shopping Mall Nine (map texture set 326, chunks 873 and 908): its pale green diamond tile floor (in45_yuka01, one diamond per tile = 16 units, as chunk 873 lays it), its stockroom wall (in45_kabe03, white with grey bands, one texture over the wall height as chunk 908) and its entrance step (in45_step01). Black caps from the lab set (285), as the other styles.

shop._doc: Poké Mart / department store: Shopping Mall Nine floor and stockroom wall (texture set 326)

shop_gate._doc: Cycling Road / Safari Zone entrance buildings: Shopping Mall Nine's plain green-grey stockroom tiles (in45_yuka03, 16 units per tile as chunk 908) and stockroom wall

shop_herb._doc: Lavaridge Herb Shop and Lilycove Department Store 1F: Black 2's Pokémon Center orange floor tiles (in02_yuka6, texture set 283, one per tile) for Sapphire's orange floor; Shopping Mall Nine wall and step

shop_pink._doc: Lilycove Department Store 5F (Poké Doll Floor): pink patterned tiles chip_yuka2 (texture set 326, one per tile) for Sapphire's pink/yellow check floor; Shopping Mall Nine wall and step

shop_roof._doc: Lilycove Department Store rooftop: grey roof tiles chip_yuka (texture set 326, one per tile); the walls around the roof are Black 2's sky-with-clouds picture in39_sora (texture set 320) so the roof stands against the sky (Sapphire: railings with the sky behind)
